must_have_properties: Conform to ISO 11898-1:2015 (default; CCCR.NISO = 0 OR iso_only_g = 1).
Support 11-bit and 29-bit identifiers (CAN Core handles both).
Support Classical CAN frame format (FDF = dominant in transmitted frame).
Support CAN FD frame format (FDF = recessive; new DLC encoding; CRC-17/CRC-21).
Bit coding by NRZ + bit stuffing in stuffed fields (SOF, ARBITRATION, CONTROL, DATA, CRC_SEQUENCE; plus STUFF_COUNT in ISO CAN FD).
Bit stuffing inserts complementary bit after 5 identical consecutive bits.
Fixed-form fields (CRC_DELIMITER, ACK_FIELD, EOF, INTERMISSION) NOT stuffed.
Bus values: dominant overrides recessive (wired-AND).
START_OF_FRAME = 1 dominant bit; all stations hard-synchronize on its leading edge.
IDENTIFIER (11 bits) transmitted MSB-first (ID-10 → ID-0); 7 MSBs (ID-10..ID-4) must not be all recessive.
Classical CAN RTR: dominant for DATA FRAME; recessive for REMOTE FRAME.
CAN FD RRS bit: always dominant (no remote frames in CAN FD).
CAN FD FDF bit: dominant = Classical, recessive = CAN FD; received FDF=1 + res=1 triggers Protocol Exception.
CAN FD BRS bit: dominant = no rate switch, recessive = switch to DBTP from BRS through CRC sequence. Only evaluated when CCCR.BRSE = 1 AND CCCR.FDOE = 1.
CAN FD ESI bit: error-active transmitter sends dominant; error-passive sends recessive; transmitter's value OR-ed with error-passive flag.
DLC encoded per Classical / CAN FD table (different mapping for codes 9..15).
Classical CRC SEQUENCE: 15-bit BCH polynomial X^15 + X^14 + X^10 + X^8 + X^7 + X^4 + X^3 + 1.
CAN FD CRC: 17-bit polynomial for payload ≤16 bytes; 21-bit polynomial for payload >16 bytes.
ISO CAN FD: 3-bit stuff-count + 1-bit parity protection prepended to CRC sequence.
CRC DELIMITER + ACK DELIMITER + each EOF bit must be recessive.
ACK SLOT: transmitter sends recessive; receivers with matched CRC respond dominant.
Active error flag = 6 dominant bits; passive = 6 recessive bits; both followed by 8 recessive ERROR DELIMITER bits.
Intermission = 3 recessive bits; no station may start transmission during it.
Error-passive transmitter adds SUSPEND TRANSMISSION (8 recessive bits) before next transmission.
Fault confinement state transitions per Transmit/Receive Error Count thresholds 128 and 256.
Bus-off node may rejoin only after 129 occurrences of Bus_Idle (129 × 11 consecutive recessive bits) following CCCR.INIT clearance.
Configuration registers writable only when CCCR.CCE = 1 AND CCCR.INIT = 1 (protected-write semantics).
Reserved register address access sets IR.ARA + asserts m_can_aei_ara.
Acceptance filter: up to 128 standard 11-bit filter elements + 64 extended 29-bit filter elements.
Rx FIFO 0 + Rx FIFO 1: each configurable up to 64 elements; configurable as blocking (default) or overwrite.
Up to 64 dedicated Rx Buffers + up to 32 Tx Buffers + up to 32 Tx Event FIFO elements.
Data phase bit time must be ≥ no shorter than arbitration bit time (DBTP rate ≥ NBTP rate).
Sum of measured TDC + TDCR.TDCO must be < 6 bit times in data phase; ≤ 127 mtq absolute.
PSR.ACT[1:0] forced to 00 (synchronizing) when Protocol Exception Event occurs.
Uncorrected Message RAM bit error (m_can_aeim_berr[1] = 1) sets IR.BEU + CCCR.INIT = 1 (prevents transmission of corrupted data).
must_not_have_properties: More than 2 OVERLOAD FRAMEs generated between two DATA/REMOTE FRAMEs.
Transmitting on the bus while in 'bus off' state (output drivers must be off + CCCR.INIT held = 1).
Using standard identifier with 7 MSBs all recessive (CAN protocol constraint).
Using Classical CAN DLC values 9..15 to encode > 8 data bytes (Classical caps at 8).
Transmitting CAN FD frames when CCCR.FDOE = 0 (frames with Tx Buffer FDF = 1 will misbehave).
Evaluating Tx Buffer BRS when CCCR.BRSE = 0 OR CCCR.FDOE = 0 (BRS ignored).
Bit rate prescaler DBRP > 2 when DBTP.TDC = 1 (TDC restricts DBRP).
Mixing ISO + non-ISO CAN FD nodes on the same bus (frame format mismatch).
Combining Restricted Operation Mode (CCCR.ASM = 1) with Loop Back Mode (TEST.LBCK = 1).
Transmit Cancellation for Tx FIFO buffers (only dedicated + Tx Queue supported).

compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Monitored bus value ≠ transmitted bit (except in arbitration recessive→dominant and ACK SLOT recessive→dominant).

compliance_failure_modes.mode: BIT ERROR (data phase, FD with BRS=1)
compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Monitored bus value at Secondary Sample Point ≠ transmitted bit during data phase.
6 consecutive identical bits in a stuffed field.
Calculated CRC ≠ received CRC SEQUENCE; in ISO CAN FD includes stuff-count parity check.

Illegal bit in a fixed-form field (CRC_DELIM, ACK_DELIM, EOF, INTERMISSION, fixed-form stuff bits in CAN FD CRC); in fixed stuff-bit error during CAN FD CRC sequence the error is reported as Form Error not Stuff Error.
Transmitter does not monitor a dominant bit during the ACK SLOT.
Received FDF = recessive AND res = recessive (reserved bit) when CCCR.PXHD = 0.

Rx Handler unable to complete acceptance filtering / message storage before next frame arbitration field; OR Tx Handler unable to read message in time (latter forces CCCR.ASM = 1 Restricted Operation Mode).
External ECC asserts m_can_aeim_berr[1]; sets CCCR.INIT = 1.
Host accesses reserved register address (or DMU / TSU reserved address when connected).

performance_of_error_detection: All global errors detected per ISO 11898-1:2015.
All local errors at transmitters detected (with SSP-aware bit-error checking in CAN FD data phase when TDC enabled).
Up to 5 randomly distributed errors per message detected.
Burst errors of length < 15 detected (Classical 15-bit CRC); higher Hamming distance with CAN FD CRC-17 / CRC-21.
Errors of any odd number detected.
ISO CAN FD's stuff-count parity protection further reduces residual error probability vs non-ISO CAN FD.
Total residual error probability for undetected corrupted messages: well below 4.7 × 10^-11 × message_error_rate (Classical bound; CAN FD better).
fields.recovery_time_bound: After detecting an error and transmitting an error frame, the M_CAN retries within tens of bit times once the bus is idle (subject to CCCR.TXP transmit pause and CCCR.DAR setting).

iso_vs_non_iso_distinction.ISO_mode_NISO_0: Frame format per ISO 11898-1:2015 with stuff-bit-count + parity protection in CRC field.
iso_vs_non_iso_distinction.non_ISO_mode_NISO_1: Frame format per Bosch CAN FD Specification V1.0 (no stuff-count protection).
iso_vs_non_iso_distinction.interoperability: ISO + non-ISO CAN FD nodes CANNOT coexist on the same bus.
